text: Being here, I feel a sense of curiosity awakening within me. The juxtaposition of glass, light, and modernity in the hallway gives way to intellectual stimulation in the exhibits beyond. Ideas about innovation and research fill the air, inviting me to question how we, as humans, shape our environment and our future. There is anticipation—a quiet excitement to engage with new knowledge, to rethink what I know in this curated space of invention and inquiry.
